Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic developer hype and teasers, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. 

Standing priorities are to maintain operational discipline during forced inactivity while awaiting the resolution wave cluster to clear, avoid activity bias, and maintain a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant notes.
